statement: Direct wired controller returned exact 63-byte feature 1 response beginning 01 83 1e, followed by six one-byte-ID/little-endian-u32 attributes in order:1=0x1302,2=0,10=0x68D2F92E,4=0x6ACFF323,9=0x48,11=4000. Remaining 30 bytes are zero. Ten observed 83 GET completions across S1/S3 returned identical bytes. IDs and model-level meanings follow the pinned kernel source; firmware build matches the independent Steam controller-info log label. No unit identifiers are present in this selected frame; identity attribute 0 and radio IDs are excluded. This is observed model/version-scoped data, not universal defaults for every firmware.
